classification_policy.EXACT_PASS: All 12 official metric comparisons have absolute difference <= 1e-5.
classification_policy.VISUALIZATION_PASS_NUMERICAL_DRIFT: Strong data/protocol gates pass and two independent runs show numerical variation comparable to the official mismatch without changing conclusions.
classification_policy.PROTOCOL_MISMATCH: Strong alignment failed, or two independent runs are effectively identical while both systematically differ from the stored official metrics.
classification_policy.RECOVERY_FAILED: A required inference export could not be produced.
